description: This file defines the YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor class for Twig. It implements the NodeVisitorInterface and manages node processing related to the 'yield' readiness attribute, including validation and deprecation warnings.

classes.name: YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor
classes.description: A Twig node visitor that checks if nodes are marked as ready for yield operations and manages related deprecation and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the visitor with an option to use yield.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon entering, verifying if it is marked with 'YieldReady' attribute and handling errors or deprecations.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Processes a node upon leaving; currently acts as a pass-through.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this visitor, set to 255.
